faq.title: Questions people ask
items: I can't shoot or edit. Will I keep up?
Weeks 5 to 8 are production and editing, phone first: Instagram Edits and VN, with Premiere Pro basics. Technical mentors run them, and you leave with one edit template you reuse.
I freeze on camera.
Week 6 is on camera: short takes, a 10-take drill, and corrections from a mentor while you are live. Nobody is expected to be good at it in Week 0.
I don't know what to post.
You do not film anything until your niche is locked. Weeks 0 to 2 end with a one-line positioning and a 21-day calendar your mentor signs off.
How much time does it take?
About 11 hours a week: 6 across the weekend live sessions, and roughly an hour on weekdays to make and post. Built around a day job.
What if I miss a live session?
Every session is recorded, with chapters, in the app. Your hot seat only happens live, so plan your weekends for the 12 weeks.
Who is this for?
Entrepreneurs, working professionals, marketers and creators who want to own their distribution instead of renting it.
Who is LevelUp?
LevelUp Learning runs masterclasses, workshops and live cohorts. This one has 10 working creators as mentors, and you meet them live from Week 0.

sample_review.title: Watch a script go from Fix to Ship
sample_review.sub: A reel script on the hot seat at a Saturday review. Tap a note to see the line it is about.

script.t: Hi guys, welcome back to my channel.
Today we're talking about something a lot of you asked about.
Rent or buy. Let's get into it.
My dad bought a house at 27. I'm 25 and I rent. Here's the maths he never showed me.
Rent on my flat: ₹22,000 a month. The EMI on the same flat: ₹41,000, for 20 years.
The difference, invested every month, is the part nobody puts in the reel.
So that's my take. Let me know in the comments!
script.fix: Run your own city's numbers tonight. The sheet is in my bio.

notes.text: Lines 1 to 3 are a warm-up. Nobody waits for a welcome. Cut them.
Line 4 is your hook and it turns up at second 9. Open with it.
End on one thing to do, not "let me know".

sample_review.ship_note: Hook in the first second, one action at the end. Post it Friday.
sample_review.after: That's every Saturday. Every post gets a call before it goes out, and you see why.
